chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from Muʿāwiyah ibn Ḥukaym, from Muʿallā ibn ʿUthmān, from Abī Baṣīr, who said:

I entered upon Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام while he was performing salat (prayer), and my guide said to me, 'There is blood on his garment.' Then when he had finished, I said to him, 'My guide informed me that there is blood on your garment.' He said, 'I have boils, and I do not wash my garment until they heal.'

key_terms.انْصَرَفَ: finished and turned away from the prayer

ai.seo_question: Does blood from boils on one's clothing have to be washed before salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام performed salat (prayer) while blood from boils was on his garment. It indicates a legal ruling concerning the extent to which blood must be removed, especially in cases of ongoing bodily sores or hardship.
